instance_type.notes: Must be a *.metal type; terraform/benchmark/variables.tf validates this.

instance_id.notes: The EC2 instance id of the exact provisioned confirmation host, recorded at provision. Binding to an instance id makes the exact host (not just its class) representable.

observed_architecture.notes: uname -m of the booted bound host. Must equal x86_64 at binding (PRD: Linux x86_64); the schema rejects any other value on an OBSERVED/BOUND record.

allocation_evidence.notes: Dedicated/exclusive allocation evidence the owner must designate and bind: the tenancy/metal observation procedure and its recorded output (e.g. DescribeInstances tenancy attribute, *.metal instance type confirmation, and the job-scoped exclusive-reservation record) proving the host is dedicated or exclusively reserved for the run.

availability_zone.notes: Recorded at provision of the bound host.

ami_id.notes: Pin only after the documented probe in terraform/benchmark/variables.tf against the real dev account (probe-before-wire).

os_identity.notes: /etc/os-release PRETTY_NAME + VERSION_ID of the pinned AMI as booted.

kernel_identity.notes: uname -r -v of the pinned AMI as booted on the bound instance type.

cpu_model.notes: lscpu model name, sockets, cores, threads, base/turbo policy.

cpu_frequency_policy.notes: Governor / turbo / SMT settings must be frozen and recorded.

thermal_power_identity_policy.value: fail-closed: any thermal throttle event, power-state anomaly, or host/tool identity mismatch during a run invalidates the run (INCONCLUSIVE, never patched or resampled around)
